description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for six different models, namely Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3, and tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The six lines in the plot represent the different models, with Base in black, FT in blue, IKE in red, MEND in brown, MEMIT in purple, and ROME in green; all lines are solid and marked with distinct shapes. The Base line starts at around 60% ACC at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to approximately 67% at 10^3. The FT line begins at around 61% and rises to about 69% over the same range. The IKE line starts at roughly 63% and reaches around 71% at 10^3. The MEND line begins at approximately 66% and increases to about 75% at 10^3. The MEMIT line starts at around 65% and rises to roughly 73% over the same range. The ROME line begins at approximately 70% and reaches around 78% at 10^3. All lines exhibit a generally increasing trend as Co-occurrence Number increases.
